gloss: to overeat; to eat too much

definitions.gloss: to overeat; to eat too much
definitions.explanation: Compound of {食|た}べる (to eat) + {過|す}ぎる (to exceed). A very common everyday word.

examples.japanese: {食|た}べ{過|す}ぎて⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: I ate too much and my stomach hurts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{食|た}べ{過|す}ぎた。
examples.english: I overate at yesterday's year-end party.

examples.japanese: ⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧もの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|た}べ{過|す}ぎないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけている→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I'm careful not to eat too many sweets.

notes:
One of the most common ～⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ compounds. Follows the productive V-stem + ⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ pattern that means "to do something too much." Conjugates as an ichidan verb.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{食|た}べ{過|す}ぎ→食べ過ぎ：28819_tabesugi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: watch out for overeating
- {食|た}べ{過|す}ぎて⟦{気持|きも}ち{悪|わる}い→気持ち悪い：07154_kimochiwarui⟧: feel sick from overeating
- つい{食|た}べ{過|す}ぎてしまう: end up overeating (unintentionally)

RELATED PATTERNS:
- ⟦{飲|の}み{過|す}ぎる→飲み過ぎる：22592_nomisugiru⟧: to drink too much
- ⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to use too much
- ⟦{働|はたら}き→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to overwork
